description: The data of a task.announced on node_query (architecture §3.12.3, implementation §10.1). Without node_id it is the census of the active fleet, which any Network Monitor instance answers; with node_id and target_topic it is the point form, which the instance that owns target_topic answers. The common fields are in data.schema.json.

node_id.description: The node the point form asks about, by its platform identity (architecture §3.12.3).

target_topic.description: The topic of the node's specialty, which routes the point form to its partition (architecture §3.7.7).
